answer: On-call coverage stops sybils: each key watches a unique live shard of the event stream and must answer probes in 12 seconds or lose a 35 POA bond. Probes hit every shard together, so one box cannot serve two shards. Design assumption: one shard needs ~1 vCPU and 2 Mbps (~$7/month), so 150 fakes cost ~$1,050/month plus 5,250 POA locked. A timing crystal keeps the window honest. Each probe names a one-time cipher that must wrap the payload, blocking sibling replay. The board paints each shard a different pigment, and a blank streak is public.
